name: Analog-Horror Pick-A-Door
description: Analog-horror 'pick a door / choose your fate' brand-comparison short (9:16, ~60-70s). Two doors: the SAFE brand (WARM-LIMINAL hangout — lone empty room, plush alone, fluorescent + warm lamp, oversized empty space) vs the BAD brand (cold-liminal descent → a credit/limit meter that drains on your arm → a screamer where a silent obsidian-headed monster appears and threatens you via VT323 textboxes + Undertale-style beeps). One unified aesthetic end-to-end: liminal-spaces / found-footage internet-horror, three lighting variants (warm / neutral / cold). Real tape hiss, chromatic aberration, mirage drift, film-leader countdown. Satirical product comparison in horror clothing. Reuses a pre-built monster character system + VHS SFX stack + Undertale-style beeps + VT323 font.
